envelope.description: Daemon and plan-tree mappings carry partFailures

body.title: Daemon and plan-tree mappings carry partFailures
body.summary: Extend the data the daemon mapping in src/daemon/analyze-rpc.ts and the plan tree's mapping in src/analyze/orchestrator/driver.ts build for a ShaperAnswerStepFailedError so it carries the JSON-safe partFailures and upstream with reason, results and report (finding 5).
acceptanceChecks: through both mappings distinct outer and inner cause messages of several failed parts are present in the data and survive a JSON round trip
the existing fields of the data are unchanged and a lookup-path failure without partFailures maps as before

tests.name: answer-failure-mapping.test.ts: HandlingBudgetError carries results and report through the daemon and plan-tree mappings
answer-failure-mapping.test.ts: both mappings carry partFailures with distinct outer and inner cause messages through a JSON round trip, and a failure without partFailures maps as before
